```{=html}
{{< include _navbar.html >}}

<!-- ── Loading / auth check ──────────────────────────────── -->
<div id="authLoading" class="auth-page" style="min-height:50vh;">
  <div class="auth-card" style="max-width:400px;">
    <p style="text-align:center; color:#888;">Checking authentication...</p>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── Dashboard content (hidden until auth verified) ────── -->
<div id="dashboardContent" style="display:none;">

  <div class="dashboard-page">
    <div class="dashboard-header">
      <h2 id="dashboardWelcome">Welcome</h2>
      <p id="studentCount"></p>
    </div>

    <div class="dashboard-grid">

      <!-- ── Create Group Card ─────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="dashboard-card">
        <h3>Groups / Classes</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle">Organize your students into groups</p>
        <hr>
        <div id="groupTabs" style="margin-bottom:1rem;"></div>
        <form onsubmit="handleCreateGroup(event)" style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem;">
          <input type="text" id="newGroupName" placeholder="New group name"
                 style="flex:1; padding:0.6rem 0.8rem; border:2px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius:8px; font-size:0.9rem;">
          <button type="submit" class="auth-btn" style="width:auto; margin-top:0; padding:0.6rem 1.2rem;">Add</button>
        </form>
        <div id="groupMessage" class="auth-message" style="display:none; margin-top:0.5rem;"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Add Students Card ─────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="dashboard-card">
        <h3>Add Students</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle">Create student accounts</p>
        <hr>

        <!-- Method tabs -->
        <div style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem; margin-bottom:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <button class="method-tab active" data-target="panelSingle">Single</button>
          <button class="method-tab" data-target="panelMultiple">Multiple</button>
          <button class="method-tab" data-target="panelImport">Import File</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Panel: Single Student -->
        <div id="panelSingle" class="method-panel active">
          <form onsubmit="handleAddSingle(event)">
            <label>Username</label>
            <input type="text" id="singleUsername" placeholder="e.g. john_doe" required
                   style="width:100%; padding:0.6rem; border:2px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:0.5rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
            <label>Group</label>
            <select id="singleGroup" class="group-select"
                    style="width:100%; padding:0.6rem; border:2px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:0.5rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
              <option value="Default">Default</option>
            </select>
            <button type="submit" class="auth-btn">Create Student</button>
            <div id="addSingleMessage" class="auth-message" style="display:none; margin-top:0.5rem;"></div>
          </form>
        </div>

        <!-- Panel: Multiple Students -->
        <div id="panelMultiple" class="method-panel">
          <form onsubmit="handleAddMultiple(event)">
            <label>Username Prefix</label>
            <input type="text" id="multiPrefix" placeholder='e.g. "Student"' required
                   style="width:100%; padding:0.6rem; border:2px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:0.5rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
            <label>Number of Accounts</label>
            <input type="number" id="multiCount" min="1" max="100" placeholder="e.g. 25" required
                   style="width:100%; padding:0.6rem; border:2px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:0.5rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
            <label>Group</label>
            <select id="multiGroup" class="group-select"
                    style="width:100%; padding:0.6rem; border:2px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:0.5rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
              <option value="Default">Default</option>
            </select>
            <p style="font-size:0.85rem; color:#888; margin:0.5rem 0;">Creates Student1, Student2, Student3, etc.</p>
            <button type="submit" class="auth-btn">Create Students</button>
            <div id="addMultipleMessage" class="auth-message" style="display:none; margin-top:0.5rem;"></div>
          </form>
        </div>

        <!-- Panel: Import from File -->
        <div id="panelImport" class="method-panel">
          <form onsubmit="handleImportSubmit(event)">
            <label>Upload .txt file (one username per line)</label>
            <input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".txt" onchange="handleFileSelect(this)"
                   style="width:100%; padding:0.6rem; margin-bottom:0.5rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
            <label>Group</label>
            <select id="importGroup" class="group-select"
                    style="width:100%; padding:0.6rem; border:2px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:0.5rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
              <option value="Default">Default</option>
            </select>
            <!-- File preview table -->
            <div id="filePreview" class="hidden" style="margin:0.5rem 0; max-height:200px; overflow-y:auto;">
              <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.85rem;">
                <thead><tr><th style="text-align:left; padding:0.3rem; border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0;">#</th><th style="text-align:left; padding:0.3rem; border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0;">Username</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody id="filePreviewBody"></tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <button type="submit" class="auth-btn">Import Students</button>
            <div id="importMessage" class="auth-message" style="display:none; margin-top:0.5rem;"></div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Student List Card ─────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="dashboard-card" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
        <h3>Your Students</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle" id="studentCount2">Loading...</p>
        <hr>
        <div style="overflow-x:auto;">
          <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">
            <thead>
              <tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #e0e0e0;">
                <th style="text-align:left; padding:0.75rem 0.5rem; color:#006C93;">Username</th>
                <th style="text-align:left; padding:0.75rem 0.5rem; color:#006C93;">Group</th>
                <th style="text-align:left; padding:0.75rem 0.5rem; color:#006C93;">Created</th>
                <th style="text-align:right; padding:0.75rem 0.5rem; color:#006C93;">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="studentTableBody">
              <tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center; color:#888; padding:2rem;">Loading students...</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Danger Zone Card ──────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="dashboard-card danger" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
        <h3>Danger Zone</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle">Permanently delete your account and all student data</p>
        <hr>
        <p style="color:#666; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:1rem;">This will delete your teacher account and all associated student accounts. This action cannot be undone.</p>
        <button class="danger-btn" onclick="handleDeleteTeacher()">Delete My Account and All Students</button>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<!-- ── Dashboard auth check + init ────────────────────────── -->
<script>
(function() {
  function initDashboard() {
    if (typeof _supabase === 'undefined' || !_supabase) {
      setTimeout(initDashboard, 200);
      return;
    }

    _supabase.auth.getSession().then(function(result) {
      var session = result.data.session;

      if (!session) {
        window.location.href = 'login-teacher.html';
        return;
      }

      _supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('username, role')
        .eq('id', session.user.id)
        .single()
        .then(function(profileResult) {
          var profile = profileResult.data;

          if (!profile || profile.role !== 'teacher') {
            window.location.href = '/';
            return;
          }

          // Show dashboard
          document.getElementById('authLoading').style.display = 'none';
          document.getElementById('dashboardContent').style.display = 'block';

          // Set welcome message
          var welcomeEl = document.getElementById('dashboardWelcome');
          if (welcomeEl) welcomeEl.textContent = 'Welcome, ' + profile.username;

          // Store teacher data for admin.js
          currentTeacher = { session: session, profile: profile };

          // Load data
          loadGroups();
          loadStudents();
          initMethodTabs();
        });
    });
  }

  initDashboard();
})();
</script>

<script src="js/admin.js"></script>
```
